no_overclaim: This package proves an exact finite-cut quantum B(H)/CCR construction and balanced-even-M periodic state-transport diagram only for the inserted one-dimensional fixed regulator. It does not prove invariance of one fixed nonlinear Weyl C-star algebra, a stationary or preferred state, a physical vacuum or below-empty-space sign, compatibility across regulators, a continuum/Hadamard state, the original 3D Q3LOCK parent, derived hbar, physical time, nullness, Lorentzian signature, light speed, cooling, a phase transition, gravity, a horizon or a cycle. It does not close C0 or N1-N5, advance C6, complete CP1, or complete Pre-A.
